note_en: 谁 can work as an indefinite pronoun, "anyone" or "no one," especially with 也/都: 谁也没有打算辞职在家 "neither of them planned to quit and stay home." When 谁 appears twice, it links two people: 谁也不觉得应该谁多做一点 "neither thinks the other should do more," and 谁有时间谁就做 "whoever has time does it." English needs different words (whoever, neither, the other) where Chinese simply repeats 谁.
